interface.shortDescription: A real paper every morning, from your private newsroom.
interface.longDescription: A print-first personal newspaper your agent composes and code renders. Your sources and preferences live in files you own, not a feed you rent. Setup interviews you and builds your private newsroom; edition makes today's paper; writing is the revision discipline for everything it prints.
